title: Expose Metrics with Micrometer and Prometheus
title_es: Exponer Métricas con Micrometer y Prometheus
description: Micrometer + Prometheus examples: Counter, Gauge with weak-reference caveat, Timer with publishPercentiles and manual Timer.Sample on a field, DistributionSummary, @Counted/@Timed with CountedAspect bean, MeterBinder with injected state, standalone PrometheusMeterRegistry with the Prometheus client 1.x HTTPServer builder, plus application.yml and prometheus.yml scrape config.
description_es: Ejemplos de Micrometer + Prometheus: Counter, Gauge con advertencia de referencia débil, Timer con publishPercentiles y Timer.Sample manual sobre un campo, DistributionSummary, @Counted/@Timed con bean CountedAspect, MeterBinder con estado inyectado, PrometheusMeterRegistry standalone con el builder HTTPServer del cliente Prometheus 1.x, más application.yml y config de scrape prometheus.yml.
